# Offering

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Offering`](gmeow-Offering.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Offering>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/organization`](../../slices/organization.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A commercial offer to provide some item — a product, a service, an engagement — by an agent. Projects to [schema:Offer.](https://schema.org/Offer.) The item is named by [`gmeow:itemOffered`](../properties/gmeow-itemOffered.md); the provider by [`gmeow:offeringProvider`](../properties/gmeow-offeringProvider.md).

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to model a commercial offer to provide some item — a product, service, or engagement — by an agent; the reified offer behind the flat [`gmeow:makesOffer`](../properties/gmeow-makesOffer.md) edge.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it for the item itself (that is the [`gmeow:itemOffered`](../properties/gmeow-itemOffered.md) — a [`gmeow:ServiceOffering`](gmeow-ServiceOffering.md) or product) and avoid a flat price here (that is finance-slice measurement or the presentational [`gmeow:priceRange`](../properties/gmeow-priceRange.md)).

### How to use

- Mint a [`gmeow:Offering`](gmeow-Offering.md), name its provider with [`gmeow:offeringProvider`](../properties/gmeow-offeringProvider.md) and its item with [`gmeow:itemOffered`](../properties/gmeow-itemOffered.md), add [`gmeow:areaServed`](../properties/gmeow-areaServed.md) and [`gmeow:hasOpeningHours`](../properties/gmeow-hasOpeningHours.md) as needed; attach it to the provider with [`gmeow:makesOffer`](../properties/gmeow-makesOffer.md).

### Examples

- ex:hostingOffer a [`gmeow:Offering`](gmeow-Offering.md); [`gmeow:offeringProvider`](../properties/gmeow-offeringProvider.md) ex:acme; [`gmeow:itemOffered`](../properties/gmeow-itemOffered.md) ex:hostingService.
